chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Yusuf ibn Ya'qub Abu al-Hasan al-Ja'fi narrated to us, saying: Isma'il ibn Mihran narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza narrated to us, from his father and Wuhayb from Abu Baseer, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Let one of you prepare himself for the appearance of al-Qa'im even with one arrow, for if Allah, the Exalted, knows that from his intention, I hope that He will prolong his life until he meets him, and he becomes one of his assistants and supporters.

key_terms.أَعْوَان: Assistants or helpers of the Imam
key_terms.أَنْصَار: Supporters or partisans of the Imam
key_terms.الْقَائِم: Al-Qa'im (The Risen One), a title for the Twelfth Imam
key_terms.سَهْمًا: An arrow, symbolizing minimal preparation or readiness
key_terms.نِيَّة: Intention, the inner motive behind actions

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of preparing for the appearance of al-Qa'im according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the virtue of *sabr* (patience) and active readiness for the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi, noting that even minimal preparation like a single arrow suffices for the sincere believer. He highlights divine grace, promising that God may extend the lifespan of those with pure intention to ensure they witness and support the Imam, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatology regarding the 'Long Occultation' (al-Ghayba al-Kubra).
